en.Russia-Vietnam Science-Technology Intell: Russia-Vietnam Science-Technology Intelligence Network connects scientists, publications, research topics, organizations, businesses and projects into a cross-border knowledge network — where the Russia–Vietnam map is not only to see geography, but to see link flows, cooperation signals and opportunities to form real consortiums.
en.Tri thức liên kết xuyên Nga – Việt: Knowledge links across Russia and Vietnam
en.Gợi ý đối tác có lý do giải thích: Suggest your partner has an explanation

en.nhóm thành phần tối thiểu trong mô hình: minimal group of components in the 2+2 model
en.Một mạng tri thức Nga–Việt đang chuyển đ: A Russian-Vietnamese knowledge network is moving.
Each expert does not stand alone.
en.Hồ sơ của họ được đặt trong ngữ cảnh của: Their profiles are placed in the context of the publication, research topic, organization, project and relevant professionals. From one data point, Portal opens up an entire chain of relationships for users to explore knowledge and find opportunities for Russian-Vietnamese cooperation.
en.Chuyên môn, hướng nghiên cứu và công bố: Expertise, research directions and publications on generating pairing signals.
en.Khám phá các quan hệ phù hợp giữa hệ sin: Explore appropriate relationships between the ecosystems of Vietnam and the Russian Federation.
en.Mạng lưới tri thức là lớp dẫn đường tới: The knowledge network is the gateway layer to partners, consortia and bilateral projects.
en.· từ dữ liệu khoa học phân tán đến quan: From distributed scientific data to discoverable and actionable relationships.
A digital infrastructure. Three strategic capabilities.
Identity and governance create a foundation of trust. Knowledge networks create discovery capacity. The 2+2 process turns the connection into a bilateral research-business cooperation structure.
en.Cổng danh tính thống nhất cho toàn Porta: The identity portal is unified for the entire Portal, determining who the user is, what context they are in and what they are allowed to do.
en.Biến dữ liệu khoa học phân tán thành mạn: Turn distributed scientific data into a searchable, interconnected knowledge network that supports partner pairing.
en.Hình thành cấu trúc hợp tác cân bằng giữ: Form a balanced cooperation structure between research and businesses of both Vietnam and the Russian Federation.
en.Đi từ một truy vấn đến cả hệ sinh thái t: Go from a query to an entire knowledge ecosystem.
en.Người dùng không cần biết dữ liệu nằm ở: Users do not need to know which "warehouse" the data is in. A comprehensive search experience can lead from publications to authors, topics, organizations, projects and related experts throughout the Russian-Vietnamese network.
en.Khám phá nội dung theo ý nghĩa, không ch: Discover content for meaning, not just keyword matching.
en.Hiển thị lý do phù hợp: chủ đề, công bố,: Show relevant reasons: topic, publication, research direction.
en.Mô hình 2+2: cấu trúc hợp tác chiến lược: 2+2 model: strategic cooperation structure between research and application.
en.2+2 không chỉ là bốn ô thông tin. Đây là: 2+2 is more than just four boxes of information. This is the minimum cooperation framework to connect an institute/school and a business of the Russian Federation with an institute/school and a business of Vietnam - creating a balanced cooperation system, capable of research, testing, application and commercialization.
en.Phía Nga cung cấp năng lực nghiên cứu ch: The Russian side provides in-depth research capacity, experimental facilities, background technology and application and industrialization capabilities in the business ecosystem.
en.Bổ sung chuyên môn, công nghệ, phòng thí: Additional expertise, technology, laboratories and research team.
en.Năng lực ứng dụng, công nghiệp hóa và ti: Application capacity, industrialization and access to the Russian market.
en.Một cấu trúc hợp tác tối thiểu nhưng đủ: A minimal but sufficient collaborative structure to go from research to practical application.
en.Phía Việt Nam mang vào bài toán năng lực: The Vietnamese side brings to the problem research capacity, knowledge development, application testing and a network of businesses that need to deploy, produce and expand the market.
en.Tạo và phát triển tri thức, công nghệ, n: Create and develop knowledge, technology, and research capacity.
en.Nhu cầu ứng dụng, thử nghiệm, sản xuất v: Application, testing, production and market needs.
en.Mỗi quốc gia đều có một khối nghiên cứu: Each country has a research sector and a business sector, helping cooperation go beyond academic exchange.
en.Cấu trúc 2+2 phù hợp để xoay quanh một c: The 2+2 structure is suitable to revolve around a specific topic, technology or application need.
en.Portal không chỉ ghép nối đối tác mà còn: Portal not only pairs partners but also leads to a collaborative structure that can form bilateral consortiums.
en.Từ một điểm tri thức đến một quan hệ hợp: From a point of knowledge to a true partnership.
en.Russia-Vietnam Science-Technology Intell: Russia-Vietnam Science-Technology Intelligence Network does not stop at displaying records or publishing. The knowledge network helps users go from exploring the topic, finding the right expert, understanding the reasons for pairing and moving towards a 2+2 bilateral cooperation structure.
en.Từ công bố → chuyên gia → tổ chức → cơ h: From announcement → expert → organization → cooperation opportunity.
en.Tìm kiếm toàn cổng theo chủ đề, lĩnh vực: Search the entire portal by topic, field, organization, country and knowledge object.
en.Gợi ý chuyên gia và đối tác dựa trên côn: Suggest experts and partners based on publications, research directions and interpretable similarity signals.
en.Chuyển kết nối phù hợp thành cấu trúc ng: Transform appropriate connections into Russian–Vietnamese research-business structures around a common goal or technology.
en.Biến mạng tri thức Nga–Việt thành năng l: Turning the Russian-Vietnamese knowledge network into actionable collaborative capacity.
en.Russia-Vietnam Science-Technology Intell: Russia-Vietnam Science-Technology Intelligence Network does not stop at digitizing data. Portal creates a connection layer between people, knowledge, organizations and projects — so that from a publication you can find experts, from experts you can find partners, and from partners a Russian-Vietnamese cooperation structure can be formed that can be implemented in practice.
